clips.title: The story
paras: In the northern Barrens, a broken samophlange draws the notice of curious engineers. Its gears and shifting parts hint at a purpose no one has uncovered.

The broken samophlange is a baffling contraption from the northern Barrens. Its moving assemblies and fine gears show careful workmanship, even in ruin. Sputtervalve, a goblin in Ratchet, damaged the delicate device by accident before anyone could document how it worked. The finder hoped to send working results to curious colleagues in Undermine, so they sought someone able to repair it. Wenikee Boltbucket, a clever tinkerer near the border outpost of Mor'shan Rampart, was the one they turned to.

Wenikee Boltbucket cannot tell what a samophlange is meant to do, even after examining its ruined parts. Its clockwork sounds and shifting motion catch her interest, though. Rather than discard it as junk, she sets out to repair the device and see its mechanisms working at full capacity.
